entry.name: live.menu
entry.description: The live.menu object can be used to display text associated with incoming numbers and provide a general user interface. Item numbering starts from zero (0).

attributes.name: active
attributes.description: Toggles the object's active mode. When theattribute is set to 0, the mouse action does not cause output and the inactive colors are used. The default is 1 (on).

attributes.name: activebgcolor
attributes.description: Sets the background color of the display when theattribute is set to 1.

choices.label: The text appears with the boundaries of the text box. All attributes, except those with 'lcd' in the name, are functional.

attributes.name: param_connect
attributes.description: Establishes a two-way connection between the object and a parameter of a compatible object with parameters such asor. The object can be used to change the value of the parameter and will update if the parameter value changes. The easiest way to setis with the attribute's menu in theor the Connect submenu of the. The menu displays all available parameters of compatible objects.Setting theattribute with a message requires the target parameter's path, which is the host object's scriping name followed by two colons and the parameter name. For example, for aobject with scripting name, the path of theparameter would be. You can set a value for thebefore the host object or parameter exists, and the object will connect to the parameter once it exists. Refer to the user guide entry forfor more details.

messages.name: (mouse)
messages.digest: Click to select a menu itam
messages.description: Clicking with the mouse lets you select a menu item to be displayed and outputs information about its index and the symbol associated with that menu index.

messages.name: assign
messages.description: The word, followed by a floating point value, causes that value to be displayed and sent out theobject's outlet. The value, however, will not be stored. If the Parameter Visibility attribute is set to Stored Only, themessage will not add the new value to the Live application’s undo chain.

messages.name: bang
messages.digest: Send the current item out the outlets
messages.description: Sends the current item out the outlets.

messages.name: float
messages.digest: Display a menu item and output its index and symbol

messages.name: init
messages.digest: Restore and output the initial value
messages.description: Restore and output the initial value.

messages.name: int
messages.digest: Display a menu item and output its index and symbol
messages.description: An integer specifies a menu item to be displayed, and causes theobject to display that item and output information about its index and the symbol associated with that menu index. Menu item numbering starts at 0.

messages.name: outputvalue
messages.digest: Send the current value out the outlet
messages.description: Sends the current value out the outlet.

messages.name: rawfloat
messages.digest: Store a raw normalized value, convert to real, display, and output
messages.description: A raw normalized value (between 0. and 1.) received in the inlet is converted to a real value, stored, displayed by, and the current item is sent out the outlets.

messages.name: set
messages.digest: Display a menu item without triggering output
messages.description: The word, followed by a number, specifies a menu item to be displayed by theobject without triggering any output.

messages.name: setsymbol
messages.digest: Select a menu item for display without triggering output
messages.description: The word, followed by a message, selects a menu item to be displayed by name without triggering any output.

messages.name: symbol
messages.digest: Select a menu item for display by name
messages.description: The word, followed by a message, selects a menu item to be displayed by name. If the item is found, the menu item is displayed and information about its index and the symbol associated with that menu index.
